title: Florida State fires athletic director Michael Alford
content:
Florida State fired athletic director Michael Alford, the school announced Monday.

The decision prompts the question: Is football coach Mike Norvell next?

Although Alford did not hire Norvell, he took over as the Seminole Boosters’ president and CEO early in Norvell’s tenure. In 2022, Alford became FSU’s AD and Norvell’s boss.

In both roles, Alford helped modernize the Seminoles. Florida State spent years behind in the facilities arms race — one reason why head coach Jimbo Fisher left for Texas A&M in 2017 — but caught up last year. FSU spent about $380 million building a football operations center, which had been discussed for almost a decade, and renovating Doak Campbell Stadium.

But the investment in infrastructure came as college football pivoted to paying players directly. Firm figures are hard to come by, but people in and around Florida State and across the industry have put the Seminoles’ player payroll around the middle of the ACC.

Norvell is in the middle of what appears to be a make-or-break seventh season. He’s 39-35 overall and 1-1 this season heading into Saturday’s game at No. 10 Alabama.

This story will be updated.
